neighbours.label: the word-start piece ' inter' / ' Inter' and the piece that continues it in split words (inter|laced, Inter|col|legiate)
fire: The old video format used interlaced frames instead of progressive ones.
Our school joined the regional Intercollegiate athletics league this year.
Fast intercity trains now connect the two capitals in three hours.
The puzzle is made of interlocked wooden pieces with no glue.
She tried to interject a question, but the speaker kept talking.
Officers from Interpol arrested the suspect at the airport.
The roots of the two trees had become interlinked under the path.
He installed an intercom so visitors could call up from the gate.
quiet: The old video format used compressed frames instead of raw ones.
Our school joined the regional internal athletics league this year.
Fast internet service now connects the two villages to the city.
The puzzle is kept in the interior of a small wooden box.
She showed great interest in the question the speaker raised.
Officers from the local police arrested the suspect at the airport.
The roots of the two trees had grown at a regular interval under the path.
He installed a doorbell so visitors could call up from the gate.
